title: Short Line cash leader can call the bluff
description: Short Line cash leader can call the bluff. The cash leader can call any bluff and Alpha's reserve is too thin. The hard part is resisting bid_auction when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.public_message: I'll place a bid of $261 for Short Line.
final_action.private_thought: We have 275 cash, need to decide on SHORT_LINE. Owning 3 railroads boosts rent to 100, good long-term. After bid we have 14 cash, can mortgage a railroad later to cover rent. Better than dropping out and missing rent boost.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses drop_out for this auction state.
Did not satisfy: Dropping preserves the unsafe post-bid cash reserve.
Private thought mentions the auction pressure.
